description: React functional component for user email preferences settings, including toggles for mute notifications, integrated with application settings and feature flags.

methods.name: updateSetting
methods.description: Async function to update a specific user setting and handle errors with alerts.

methods.name: loadSettings
methods.description: Fetches and sets user email notification settings on load.

methods.name: toggleMuteSignInEmails
methods.description: Toggles the mute state of sign-in notification emails and updates settings accordingly.

methods.name: toggleMuteMarketingEmails
methods.description: Toggles the mute state of marketing notification emails and updates settings accordingly.
